title: hepetis devansayana
intro: Hepetis devansayana, commonly known as Indian coleus, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae, native to tropical Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hepetis devansayana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
